title: Can a robot baptized?
text: Can a robot baptized? It turns out water is never the problem. I chatted with GPT a whole argument on this theology question, the essay version is too dry and boring, so I ask GPT to write me a funny Sci-fi story instead. What if the AGI that rules the world says it believes in Jesus?

title: It turns out everything is still the same after you reach the other shore of the AI migration.
text:
It turns out everything is still the same after you reach the other shore of the AI migration.

Code is the new binary
Skill/agent/harness/guardrail is the new code

Nothing is really changed.   Software is not what you build, the dark factory is what you are building now.  Yes, you have to review the skills.  You can't vibe-skilling.

If you think you are stilling building software, you are already obsoleted.

title: For a long time, we engineers think management science is just BS, who need to learn those common se
text:
For a long time, we engineers think management science is just BS, who need to learn those common sense packaged in fancy business language 

Then comes AI, suddenly all those common sense turns out to be not so common if you add AI into the mix.  You have learn the management science from first principle so that you find the right way to add AI into the work force.  It makes me realise those MBA jargon actually has real useful meaning when the great mind coined them many decades ago.  We just take those terms for granted all these years
